Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q2 2020 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of MSFT.
We delivered record revenue of $39.8 billion this quarter, representing 9% year-over-year growth.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 30 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q2 2020.
We generated $15.8 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 30 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
Thank you for the question. Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 1045 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Second question - Analyst:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Revenue guidance of $39.8 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
